candidate.goal: Propose downstream recomputation from relevant source changes while blocking missing/stale/conflicted required inputs.
candidate.consumer: Downstream parent that supplies immutable producer snapshots and required dependency identities.
useful_behavior: Availability and ingestion bounded by as_of
Snapshot revalidation prevents tampered prior/current input
Required FX references included in freshness/conflict gates

findings.observation: changed_ids is calculated over all old/new input keys, without filtering to all_required; any change can yield recompute_required.
findings.impact: A parent passing a broad shared snapshot can recompute on unrelated changes. Required IDs scope blocking, not invalidation.
findings.existing_tests: test_unrelated_expired_does_not_block covers blocking only, not changes to unrelated records.
findings.decision: Specify relevant closure for clean replacement; until qualified, do not assume required_ids restricts invalidation.

findings.observation: Previous argument holds only a dependency snapshot, not prior model/config identity. Model/config contribute to idempotency key but not state selection.
findings.impact: Unchanged source snapshot with a new model/config still reaches unchanged; consumers need an explicit computation-identity policy.
findings.existing_tests: test_config_change_changes_idempotency_key changes model_version with previous=None and checks only key difference.
findings.decision: Keep prior computation identity distinct from source identity in clean contract; do not claim config changes are covered by recomputation tests.

findings.observation: Idempotency key includes as_of; unchanged records at later as_of may produce unchanged state with a different key.
findings.impact: An effect consumer must not dispatch merely because a key changed. Time-sensitive freshness and time-sensitive calculation semantics need separate rules.
findings.existing_tests: test_same_source_does_not_rerun_on_new_poll uses s,s at the identical as_of.
findings.decision: Require a later-clock same-record case and declare whether clock advancement is semantically relevant.

proposed_cases.input: Only unrelated non-required record revision changes
proposed_cases.expected: Owner decides relevant-only invalidation policy; demonstrate actual current result first

proposed_cases.input: Unchanged source records; prior model A -> current model B
proposed_cases.expected: New computation identity requires explicit recompute or documented external responsibility

proposed_cases.input: Same records at later as_of, still fresh
proposed_cases.expected: No unintended dispatch from changed idempotency key; explicit clock relevance

method_improvement: Separate source snapshot identity, relevant dependency closure, computation identity and effect idempotency before adopting a delta-processing primitive.
scope: Evidence only; no existing controller changes, no imports, no additional worker/issue allocation.
